title: Preseason week 2 recap: Fantasy winners, losers and risers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Preseason week 2 recap: Fantasy winners, losers and risers
sources.description: What did we actually learn from Week 2 of preseason? Matt Harmon and Scott Pianowski break down the biggest fantasy takeaways, highlighting the players whose performances should have managers feeling more confident and the ones raising red flags. Plus, they identify the preseason standouts whose stock is trending up ahead of draft season.
